spec.name: M6.FiberSum.sum_by_fibers
spec.statement: ∀ (α β : Type) [Fintype α] [Fintype β] (L : α → β) (w : β → Polynomial ℤ), M6.FiberSum.pullbackSum L w = M6.FiberSum.fiberSum L w
spec.guidance: Reindex the finite domain sum by fibers using finite sum_fiberwise; each fiber has constant weight, hence cardinality times that polynomial. Return tactic lines only, no leading by.

spec.name: M6.FiberSum.uniform_weighted_sum
spec.statement: ∀ (α β : Type) [Fintype α] [Fintype β] (L : α → β) (k : ℕ), M6.FiberSum.UniformFibers L k → ∀ (w : β → Polynomial ℤ), M6.FiberSum.pullbackSum L w = Polynomial.C (k : ℤ) * ∑ b, w b
spec.guidance: Use sum_by_fibers, replace each fiber.card by k and factor finite sum. No surjectivity or k-positive assumption required. Return tactic lines only, no leading by.

spec.name: M6.FiberSum.uniform_cardinality
spec.statement: ∀ (α β : Type) [Fintype α] [Fintype β] (L : α → β) (k : ℕ), M6.FiberSum.UniformFibers L k → Fintype.card α = k * Fintype.card β
spec.guidance: Specialize weighted sum to constant1, compare coefficient0 and use exact_mod_cast; or direct cardinality by fibers. Return tactic lines only, no leading by.

spec.name: M6.Character.constant_transform
spec.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (q : M6.Character.Vector m), (q = 0 → M6.Character.localTransform (fun _ _ => (1 : Polynomial ℤ)) q = Polynomial.C ((2 : ℤ)^m)) ∧ (q ≠ 0 → M6.Character.localTransform (fun _ _ => (1 : Polynomial ℤ)) q = 0)
spec.guidance: Expand the binary coordinate sum. When q i=0 its factor is2; when q i=1 it is0. For q≠0 choose a nonzero coordinate to make the product0. Use literal q i=0∨q i=1 before simp to avoid fin_cases leaving Fin constructors. Return tactics only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Character.dual_cardinality
spec.guidance: Specialize accepted weighted_macwilliams to all coordinate weights1. WeightedDual becomes C(card dualWords). The transform sum has only q=0 contribution C(2^m), since0∈D. Compare coefficient0, then exact_mod_cast. No dimension or nondegeneracy premise; actual finite binary transform proves the result. Return tactics only without leading by.
